Name: Monteso's Bathroom Furniture (standalone)
Author: Pegasigh
Description:
Adds a bathtub, toilet, and sink into the game all with their own names, descriptions, and prices that can be purchased from Robin's shop and the furniture catalogue.

Credit for the textures goes to Monteso.

For a version that replaces the texture.xnb file instead of requiring the Custom Furniture mod please visit [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/129/?]Monteso's original Bathroom Furniture[/url].
Custom Furniture mod by Platonymous available [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254/?]here[/url].
